newsitem.title: FINLAND: RAUTARUUKKI TO INVEST IN RAAHE COILING.
newsitem.headline: RAUTARUUKKI TO INVEST IN RAAHE COILING.

text.p: Finnish steel maker Rautaruukki said on Tuesday it would invest 160 million markka in coil systems in its Raahe Steel unit's rolling mills at Raahe.
"The total costs of the coil box and coil conveyor system project are about 160 million markka," Rautaruukki said in a statement.
Rautaruukki said it had sealed a deal with German equipment maker Schloemann-Siemag AG on the purchase of a coil box and coil conveyor systems for the mill.
Rautaruukki said the project would enable Raahe Steel to increase the size of the hot-rolled coils it produces to 30 tonnes, but did not specify the previous size.
The value of the equipment deal itself, exclusive of other project costs, was not immediately available, a Rautaruukki official said.
